limitations: S.2, S.3, S.5 and SP-11.1 fail on purpose. There is no v5 Tier 2 domain (crucible.domains, workstream I), no civilisation generator (crucible.civ, workstream J) and no semantic encoder (crucible.semantic.encode, workstream D) on this branch. No other world type is counted in their place.
RapidExperienceEnv is written to INTERFACE_CONTRACTS section 8 but has not been run, because crucible.rapid (workstream H) is not merged. It is not tested against any stand-in.
The ReferenceLearner proves the interface (real updates, exact checkpoints). It is not a capable agent in worlds with 150-200 tools; that is a limit of the learner, not a fault in the environment.
Kernel observations include the full tool list every time, 88-122 KB each. The ExperienceStore stores each tool list once.
The CAM 2.0 adapter still imports agentrs when its module loads (true in 4.0 already). Its new reward-mode test, like tests/test_agents_llm.py, needs the AGENTRS source on the path.
The full regression suite was not run. I ran the 12 test files my changes could affect: 288 passed, 2 skipped. I did not check whether those 2 skips are the same as the Gate A baseline's.
integration_notes: Workstream A (substrate) was not merged at the time of either merge from feat/crucible-5-openworld; the second merge reported 'Already up to date'. When it lands, artifact.stored and artifact.published events whose payload.ref is sha256:... automatically become observation artifact references.
Workstream D: crucible.semantic.encode(world, ref, modality) is called on those artifacts once it exists. Until then SP-11.1 counts 12 of 13 kinds.

Workstream H: RapidEnv.reset() and step() should return Observation dicts (check them with crucible.experience.validate_observation). The adapter calls step({agent: action}) and reads result.reward only in legacy mode.

Workstreams I and J: make(2, ...) expects crucible.domains.<name>.DOMAIN with configs, build, objective and evaluate (section 9); make(3, ...) expects crucible.civ.generate(profile, seed, population_profile). Once those exist, S.2, S.3, S.5 and SP-11.1 can be re-run without changes.
test_gate_S.py::test_S7_parallel_environments starts four worker processes, so it must run through crucible.scale.slots --cpu 4.

Gate tests write evidence to docs/v5/evidence/gate_R, gate_S and gate_SP. These are untracked and not committed. docs/v5/evidence/checker_report.json was modified by the checker test during the regression run and I restored it.

The 4.0 native environments accept reward_mode=...; the default legacy mode is checked byte-identical against c07098b by crucible.experience.leakage.legacy_check. MechVecEnv.step_values and SelfPlayEnv.step_values are new methods, and step() now calls them.
